name: HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES_
description: HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES is used to capture all additional names/aliases, associated to a party. For example, the Legal name or Maiden Name information for a party would be stored as a entry in the HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_NAMES table with the PARTY_NAME_TYPE column storing the Legal Name or Maiden Name and PARTY_NAME_TYPE as LEGAL or MAIDEN. In addition to the seeded types, customers or applications can define additional types as needed.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier. Primary Key. System generated.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party ID. Foreign key reference to the HZ_PARTIES. The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_NAME_TYPE can be applied to.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the name. It is a value defined by the Additional Party Name and Identifier Type entity. The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_NAME_TYPE can be applied to.

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Record Status Flag used to soft delete entity. Possible values are 'A' (active), 'I' (inactive), 'D' (logically deleted), and 'M' (merged). 'M' will not be used for this entity. Default is 'A'.

columns.name: ACTUAL_CONTENT_SOURCE
columns.description: Source system that provides this name. Default with USER_ENTERED. Foreign key to HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_B

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: TCA Who column

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Typically used to store the additional name for the party. In the case of Persons it will be used to store the formatted name if necessary for the name type.

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.description: A professional or family title. For example, Don or The Right Honorable. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.description: Used to capture the Academic title for a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Degree in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT
columns.description: Used to capture the name prefix (Mr. Ms, Dr., etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Prefix in HL7. Validate against lookup CONTACT_TITLE

columns.name: PERSON_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the first name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Given Name in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the middle name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Middle Initial or Name in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.description: Used to capture the Last name prefix (e.g. 'fon', 'van', etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Last Name Prefix in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the last name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Family Name in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the second last name for a person. In some cultures it is not uncommon to have double last name. It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Used to capture the previous last name of a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. It has no mapping in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.description: Used to capture the name suffix (e.g. Junior. Sr, the third, etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the homonymous field in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Suffix in HL7.

columns.name: TRANSLITERATION_LANG
columns.description: Used to capture the language used for the name. It is validated against FND_LANGUAGES.LANGUAGE_CODE. Default value is the Session Language.

columns.name: PREFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Identify the name as preferred name for this party within this name type. Possible values are 'Y' and 'N'. Default is 'N'.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Free text comment/description.
